name: in-page-navigation
divergenceNotes: Uses USWDS-compatible markup and styling but a CoDS-authored, instance-scoped scroll tracker because the USWDS behavior would generate a second navigation alongside authored links, uses document-wide selectors, and does not clean up its observer on teardown. Approved by State design, engineering, and accessibility leads on 2026-11-11.
description: A list of links to sections of the current page with optional current-section highlighting.
